“江执屿，你知道自己现在身价有多高吗？”

电话那头，俱乐部经理林石的声音几乎是吼出来的，带着难以置信的焦躁。

“……”

“年仅17岁的世界冠军，你的竞技状态甚至还没到巅峰，结果你告诉我你要退役？！”

“……不是退役，是休息。”

“休息几年和退役有什么区别？江执屿，你再考虑一下，算我求你了……”

林石还在絮絮叨叨，语气里满是恨铁不成钢。可那些话语落在江执屿耳中，却渐渐变得模糊、遥远，最终被电脑屏幕微弱的蓝光彻底吞没。

他指尖搭在鼠标上，有一下没一下地滑动着滚轮，眼前是【归零者游戏/ZPL职业联赛官方论坛】。

＃理讨，出道即巅峰、捧杯捧到手软的R神算不算ZplGOat级的选手了＃[回复：5420]

＃关于River压枪习惯及握鼠标姿势详解，注：新手别学(很伤手)！＃[回复：2611]

＃无奖竞猜这赛季结束和rXg合约到期的River会留队还是转会＃[回复：8691]

每一条，都围绕着同一个名字——River。

这次RXG世界赛夺冠对于所有国内粉丝而言无疑是各种境界上的意外之喜。

ZPL是全球最热电子竞技联赛，可以说吸干了电竞娱乐业大盘，但国内队伍的国际竞争力一直饱受争议，甚至一度沦为垫底赛区，距离上次世界赛捧杯远在七年前。

River是ZPL近两年横空出世的天才，几乎可以说是依靠一己之力将当时只是国内联赛中下游队伍的RXG捧上神坛，打造国内联赛八连冠的历史纪录。

粉丝们对RXG在世界赛成绩的期待其实只是希望稳扎稳打、打出风采，保瑞士轮争淘汰赛。

但是谁都没想到，River扛着队伍一路碾过历届冠军，打破所有质疑，一路打进总决赛。

"Jiang Zhiyu, do you know how much you are worth now?"

On the other end of the phone, the voice of club manager Lin Shi almost shouted, with incredible anxiety.

"..."

"A world champion who is only 17 years old, your competitive status has not even reached its peak, and you tell me that you want to retire?!"

"...It's not retirement, it's rest."

"What's the difference between taking a few years off and retiring? Jiang Zhiyu, please think about it again, I beg you..."

Lin Shi was still chattering, his tone full of hatred that iron cannot become steel.But when those words fell into Jiang Zhiyu's ears, they gradually became blurry and distant, and were eventually completely swallowed up by the weak blue light of the computer screen.

He put his fingertips on the mouse and slid the scroll wheel. In front of him was [Zero Game/ZPL Professional League Official Forum].

#彩票平台•Congratulations to the RXG team for winning the Zero Player World Championship, and congratulations to the River player for winning the annual fmvp#[Reply: 15142]

Each one revolves around the same name - River.

This RXG World Championship win is undoubtedly an unexpected surprise in various realms for all domestic fans.

ZPL is the most popular e-sports league in the world. It can be said that it has sucked up the e-sports entertainment industry. However, the international competitiveness of domestic teams has always been controversial, and it was even ranked at the bottom of the competition. It was seven years ago that the last world championship was won.

River is a genius who has emerged from the ZPL in the past two years. It can be said that he single-handedly brought RXG, which was only a mid-to-lower domestic league team at the time, to the altar, setting a historical record of eight consecutive domestic league championships.

Fans' expectations for RXG's performance in the World Championship are actually just hoping to play steadily, show style, and ensure that Switzerland competes in the knockout rounds.

But no one expected that River would lead the team all the way past previous champions, break all doubts, and reach the finals.
